**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Job Title: Store Executive / Inventory & Purchase Executive**

**Location:** New Delhi, India

**About Us:**

Mira’s is a premium bakery and café in New Delhi, offering artisanal baked goods, gourmet beverages, and a thoughtfully curated guest experience. Our brand focuses on warmth, consistency, and refined service, making guest satisfaction and staff excellence equally important.

**Job Summary:**

We are looking for a diligent, detail-oriented Store Executive to manage daily store operations, raw material inventory, material receiving, and stock issuance at Mira’s. This role acts as the operational backbone connecting kitchen production, bakery, bar, and retail front-of-house teams with seamless supply availability. The Store Executive will oversee vendor deliveries, maintain accurate stock records, minimize shrinkage, and enforce strict FIFO and food safety storage standards.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Receiving, Inspection & Quality Control:**

· Receive daily deliveries of dairy, flour, chocolates, fresh produce, dry groceries, beverage supplies, and packaging materials.

· Verify incoming consignments against Purchase Orders (POs) and vendor delivery challans/invoices for quantity, weight, and pricing accuracy.

· Inspect perishable and temperature-sensitive goods for freshness, expiry dates, temperature logs, and quality standards, rejecting defective shipments immediately.

**2. Storage, FIFO & Inventory Management:**

· Ensure systematic storage of raw materials across dry store rooms, walk-in chillers, and deep freezers.

· Strictly enforce FIFO (First-In, First-Out) and FEFO (First-Expired, First-Out) principles to prevent ingredient aging and spoilage.

· Issue raw materials and packaging supplies to the bakery, kitchen, bar, and front-of-house against authorized requisition slips.

· Conduct weekly and month-end physical stock audits, reconciling physical counts against ERP/POS inventory logs to report discrepancies.

**3. Indenting, Requisitions & Vendor Coordination:**

· Monitor minimum reorder levels (ROP) for critical raw materials, packaging, and disposables to ensure uninterrupted café operations.

· Prepare daily/weekly purchase indents in coordination with Head Chef, Pastry Chef, and Store Manager.

· Coordinate with approved vendors and logistics partners to ensure on-time delivery schedules and handle invoice submissions to accounts.

**4. Hygiene, Waste Logging & Record Keeping:**

· Maintain immaculate hygiene, pest-free cleanliness, and proper organization within all storage facilities.

· Maintain accurate daily logs for stock wastage, kitchen returns, breakages, and expired items.

· Update daily stock movement entries into Excel/ERP inventory systems (Petpooja or dedicated inventory modules).

**Qualifications & Skills:**

· Graduate in Commerce, Hotel Management, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.

· 2–4 years of experience as a Store Executive, Inventory Executive, or Receiving Officer in a restaurant, bakery, café, hotel, or food retail establishment.

· Working knowledge of inventory management systems, restaurant POS inventory modules (e.g., Petpooja), and MS Excel.

· Strong understanding of food storage standards, cold-chain maintenance, FIFO, and FSSAI hygiene guidelines.

· Good numerical accuracy, analytical ability, and record-keeping discipline.

· Strong interpersonal and coordination skills with vendors and internal culinary teams.

**What We Offer:**

· Budgeted Salary: ₹18,000 – ₹25,000 per month (commensurate with relevant experience).

· Opportunity to manage procurement and inventory operations for a fast-expanding premium artisanal brand.

· Stable, structured, and professional working environment.

· Career advancement opportunities within supply chain and store management.

**Job Types:** Full-time, Permanent

**Interested candidates can share their CV at:** hr@mirasdelhi.com or 8545037610

description:
**About us**

Dr. Sobti’s Dental Care is a premium, implant-focused dental practice in West Delhi, specializing in full-arch and All-on-X implant dentistry — with an in-house digital lab, CBCT, intraoral scanning and an attached dental academy. We run a high-value, high-trust practice, and we’re hiring one person to take complete ownership of how the clinic runs, converts and presents itself.

**The role**

This is a single point of accountability for everything between a lead and a completed, happy patient. You run the floor, lead the team, audit every part of the funnel, build our referral and PR relationships, and drive our conversion rate up — measurably and repeatedly. This is a hands-on command role for a true one-person-army, not a desk job.

**Location:** Rajouri Garden, West Delhi — on-site, full-time  
**Reports to:** Founder-Directors  
**Compensation:** ₹40,000/month fixed + performance incentive on gross monthly collections. **On-target total earnings ₹1.4–2 lakh+/month** for a strong performer.  
**Experience required:** 4–5 years managing a clinic or healthcare setup (dental strongly preferred)

**What you’ll own**

**1. The floor & daily operations.** Run the clinic day to day — patient flow, scheduling, the front desk, inventory coordination, and the overall patient experience from the moment they walk in. The floor is yours.

**2. The team (people & performance).** Manage the entire patient-facing and support team — front desk, lead callers, treatment coordinators, assistants. Set standards, build rosters and SOPs, train, hold people accountable, and handle the HR function for these roles: performance reviews, discipline, and keeping the team motivated and honest.

**3. Leads & calls — data-driven auditing.** Audit every lead and every call across Google, Meta, WhatsApp and walk-ins. Verify call activity against the phone/dialer logs (not self-reported task sheets), track response time and follow-up discipline, and find and plug every leak between enquiry and visit. You run on evidence, not impressions.

**4. Patient conversion.** Own the numbers at every funnel stage — lead → call → booked → shown-up → consult → treatment accepted → treatment done → recall. Lead and coach the treatment-coordination team on the floor so more patients commit to treatment. Understand every reason a patient says no, and systematically raise treatment acceptance.

**5. Marketing, design & digital presence.** Audit our content, campaigns, brand consistency and performance across Instagram, Google and YouTube. Judge ROI on marketing spend, hold design and content to a standard, and make sure our presence matches a premium implant practice.

**6. PR & referral network.** Be the clinic’s PR front — patient experience, reviews and testimonials, and the brand we project. Build and maintain referral relationships with doctors and partner practices to grow our referral pipeline.

**7. Reporting.** Maintain a weekly funnel scoreboard — by source, by stage, by team member — and report performance and fixes directly to the founders.

**What success looks like**

* *First 90 days:* a working weekly audit rhythm across all the above, with clean call-log-verified reporting, and an early lift in call-to-visit and visit-to-conversion rates.
* *First 6 months:* a measurable, sustained multi-fold improvement in overall conversion; faster, cleaner lead response with no avoidable drop-offs; a disciplined, accountable team; a growing referral pipeline; and a visibly stronger patient experience and brand presence.

**You’re a fit if you have**

* **4–5 years running a clinic or healthcare setup** (dental practice experience strongly preferred). We will not consider candidates with no clinical/healthcare operations background.
* A genuine **audit mindset** — comfortable with KPIs, funnels, call logs and numbers, and willing to hold both people and processes to account.
* Proven **conversion / sales ability** — you can turn a hesitant patient into a confident yes, and teach others to do the same.
* Real **leadership presence** — you can run a team, set standards and have difficult conversations.
* Excellent **communication and interpersonal skills** — you’ll be the face of the clinic to patients and referring doctors, and the backbone to staff.
* Working comfort with CRM / lead systems and social/reputation platforms (or the ability to learn fast).

**Good to have**

* Experience in a dental or implant/aesthetic practice
* Exposure to treatment-coordination or patient-counselling
* Familiarity with digital marketing metrics

**This role is NOT for you if** you want a 9-to-5 desk job, you need to be told what to do, or you’ve only done one slice of this (only front desk, or only marketing). We’re hiring someone who owns the whole system.

**What we offer**

* A senior, high-autonomy role with direct access to the founders
* A performance incentive tied to real conversion growth — strong earning upside for a performer
* A premium, fast-growing implant practice with real infrastructure (digital lab, CBCT, academy) to work with
* Room to build and lead, not just maintain

title: Senior Paid Search Specialist
description:
**About Darkroom**
------------------

**Darkroom** is the leading next\-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.


At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by **Shadow**, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive\-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.


Our track record speaks for itself: **billions in attributable revenue** driven across e\-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.


What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the **fastest\-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000\)** and among the **most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos)**. Our founders were recognized by **Forbes 30 Under 30** for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

**About the Role**
------------------


We are hiring for our Paid Media team, looking for a **Senior Paid Search Specialist** \- a performance\-driven marketer with a strong mastery of paid search advertising systems, the evolving AI search environment, and a deep understanding of the AI ecosystem and emerging ad platforms. This is not just a tactical role; it requires strategic thinking, cross\-functional collaboration, and high standards of execution across digital advertising platforms, particularly Google, YouTube, Bing, and emerging AI platforms like Kontext, Koah, Perplexity, Claude, and OpenAI (some of these platforms don’t have ad services yet). Though primarily focused on Google, the role will require expertise and campaign deployment on other paid search based platforms as well, and a willingness to try new platforms as AI search product evolve.


Perfect candidates will be obsessed with Paid Search Advertising, experts at search buying behavior, with a clear demonstrated history of selling products through paid search advertising, scaling ad accounts upwards of $1M USD per month, and having excellent client relationship management skills. You live and breath ads manager, you are curious about the emerging AI advertising ecosystem, and performance marketing at large. You want to be a part of the best team in the business at scaling brands through digital advertising.


You’ll report to the Managing Director of the department and play a key role in scaling paid media campaigns across a portfolio of high\-growth consumer brands. You’ll be responsible for owning creative strategy, campaign builds, optimization, and reporting, while working closely with creative, creator, brand and analytics teams to ensure performance goals are met.


This is a fast\-paced, high\-accountability environment designed for marketers who are ambitious, curious, and ready to grow. You’ll gain hands\-on experience in a broad range of platforms and verticals, while developing the skills needed to lead performance strategies end\-to\-end.


Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

**This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone (9 AM–5 PM EST).**

**What you'll do:**
-------------------

* Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies exclusively focused on Paid Search to increase brand visibility and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.
* Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.
* Obsession with the paid search advertising action, bid system, and market dynamics to best convert customers at the lowest possible cost for the brand.
* Keen to develop innovative paid search strategies that blend traditional search, YouTube, and emerging AI search.
* Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.
* Manage between 6\-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Google, YouTube, Bing, and the emerging AI sSearch Platforms (Koah, Kontext) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $20,000 \- $3M.
* Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third\-party reporting tools, and AI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month\-over\-month and solve for attribution.
* Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, and CPM.
* Understand industry\-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e\-commerce marketing funnel.
* Implement real\-time, proactive, and reactionary ad\-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up\-or\-down trends happening on ads platforms (you will be in ad platforms daily).
* Preemptively develop quarterly strategies for clientele based on perceived success metrics, ad spends, YoY performance metrics, and projections.
* Deep dive into competitor research, industry knowns, and brand identity to manage client expectations and continually brainstorm new marketing initiatives, creative assets, copy, and review after results.
* Understand full\-funnel marketing strategies to ensure new customer acquisition is healthy within the broader e\-commerce equation.
* Understand client needs for success and preemptively deliver projections and forecasts that latter into client quarterly strategy.
* Willingness and openness to learn and understand e\-commerce P\&Ls with a comfortability engaging with financial metrics.

**What you'll need to be successful:**
--------------------------------------

* Mastery of the e\-commerce marketing funnel —\> offer to ad to landing page to conversion.
* 4\+ years minimum of paid media advertising experience within Paid Search, Google in specific (building high converting funnels and driving quantifiable results).
* 3\+ years minimum managing paid search advertising for growing clients in the consumer space spending over $400k\+ minimum monthly aggregate spend.
* Expertise in developing, testing, and optimizing advertisement copy and short form video creative
* Expertise in creative consultation for successful Paid Social Ads that convert
* Background in data\-derived decision\-making and forecasting budgets/spend projections linked to perceived results
* Experience with all core e\-commerce revenue drivers, reporting on metrics that actually matter (CPA, CAC, iROAS, aMER, CPM)

**What It's Like to Work at Darkroom**
--------------------------------------


Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world\-class talent building something remarkable.


We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.

* **Unlimited PTO \+ Local holidays (Relevant to your hub):** Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp.
* **Remote\-First Culture:** Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in\-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.
* **Parental Leave:** Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition.
* **Growth:** Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. * Refer the attrition cases to PRM immediately
* Coordinate with cross functional teams to manage Premier TAT / customer expectations

* Proactively identifies opportunities/issues and provides feedback to branch management and HTS to improve products and service processes
* Delivering the firm \- Put the client at the heart of our business and deliver joined up services and solutions aligned to customer needs.

**Operational effectiveness and control**

* Ensure all processes and procedures are accurate and in accordance with HSBC Bank policy standards, regulatory requirements, Group Compliance Policy and Internal Controls.
* Comply with local regulations in all aspects of strategy, sales processes, client correspondence, financial promotions, administration, and complaint handling

* Ensure all entries captured on WMS are error free and that the entries are reconciled everyday.
* Achieve the operational standards for the business and work within agreed procedures and guidelines \- displaying high levels of integrity at all times
* Maintain awareness of operational risk and minimize the likelihood of it occurring including its identification, assessment, mitigation and control, loss identification and reporting in accordance with section B.1\.2 of the Group Operations FIM.
* Minimum concurrent audit comments and NIL reminders
* Ensure NIL frauds for any cases sourced /handled by the branch.
* Ensure use of RMP for activity management and referring leads to PRMs

* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities

* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD \& EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.

* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers

* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**

* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures in order to handle client needs
* Proactively help HSBC identify opportunity to improve process efficiencies
* Sensitively redirect clients to the most effective and efficient channel

**Additional Information**
